text: Shujaa Mwakilishi wa Baraza la Wawakilishi John Lewis atazikwa Alhamisi baada ya ibada ya maziko yake huko Atlanta .
trans_text: Representative and hero of the House of Representatives John Lewis will be buried Thursday after his funeral service in Atlanta.

text: Marais wastaafu Barack Obama , Bill Clinton na George W . Bush wanatarajiwa kuwa kati ya waombolezaji watakaohudhuria mazishi katika Kanisa la Ebenezer Baptist , eneo la kihistoria ambapo Martin Luther King Jr . alikuwa akihubiri .
trans_text: Retired presidents Barack Obama, Bill Clinton, and George W. Bush are expected to be among the mourners attending the funeral at Ebenezer Baptist Church, the historic site where Martin Luther King Jr. used to preach.

text: Obama anatarajiwa kuzungumza katika ibada hiyo ya kumuaga Lewis .
trans_text: Obama is expected to speak at the funeral service for Lewis.

text: Baada ya hapo Lewis atapelekwa kuzikwa katika eneo la makaburi ya South View mjini Atlanta .
trans_text: After that, Lewis will be taken to be buried in the cemetery area of South View in Atlanta.

text: Marehemu alikufa wiki iliyopita kutokana na saratani akiwa na umri wa miaka 80 .
trans_text: The deceased died wiki iliyopita from cancer at the age of 80.

text: Lewis alitumikia Baraza la Wawakilishi kwa miaka 33 akiwa ni mwakilishi kutoka wilaya ya uwakilishi ya tano ya jimbo la Georgia inayoijumuisha Atlanta .
trans_text: Lewis served in the House of Representatives for 33 years as a representative from Georgia's fifth congressional district, which includes Atlanta.

text: Waombolezaji walijipanga katika mitaa mbalimbali katika njia ambapo gari lililokuwa limeubeba mwili wa Lewis lilipita Jumatano likiupeleka mwili wa marehemu katika jengo la bunge .
trans_text: Mourners lined up in various streets along the route where the vehicle carrying the body of Lewis passed on Jumatano as it transported the deceased's body to the parliament building.

text: Watu wengi walisimama katika mistari mirefu kutoa heshima zao mbele ya jeneza lililokuwa limefunikwa kwa bendera , wakati muda wa kutoa heshima uliongezwa zaidi ili kuwawezesha wale wote waliotaka kutoa heshima zao kufanya hivyo .
trans_text: Many people stood in long lines to pay their respects before the flag-draped coffin, as the time for paying respects was extended further to allow all those who wished to pay their respects to do so.

text: Katika hafla hiyo , Gavana wa Georgia Brian Kemp alisema Lewis """" alikuwa kipenzi cha watu wa Georgia , """" shujaa wa Marekani na rafiki kwa wale wote waliokuwa wanataka maisha bora , haki , na jamii iliyokuwa na mshikamano zaidi . """"
trans_text: At that event, Governor Georgia Brian Kemp said Lewis was a beloved figure of the people of Georgia, a hero of Marekani and a friend to all who wanted a better life, justice, and a more united community.

text: Ibada ya Alhamisi ndio inahitimisha wiki nzima ya maadhimisho ya kuenzi maisha ya Lewis .
trans_text: The Alhamisi service concludes the entire week of celebrations honoring the life of Lewis.

text: Mwili wake ulipitishwa Jumapili katika daraja la Selma , Alabama ambapo akiwa kijana mwaka 1965 alikuwa kati ya waandamanaji wanaodai haki za kiraia waliopigwa na askari wa jimbo hilo .
trans_text: His body was carried across Jumapili at the Edmund Pettus Bridge in Alabama, where as a young man in 1965 he was among the civil rights demonstrators beaten by state troopers.

text: Mwili wa Lewis uliwekwa katika Bunge la Marekani Washington kwa siku mbili kabla ya kuondoshwa na kupelekwa Georgia kwa mazishi .
trans_text: The body of Lewis was placed in the Marekani Washington Capitol for two days before being removed and taken to Georgia for burial.
